newsitem.title: USA: Gantos September same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Gantos September same store sales rise.

text.p: Gantos Inc said Thursday its same store sales for the five week period ended October 5, 1996 rose five percent from the comparable period a year ago.
Total sales for the five weeks also increased five percent to $17.9 million, an increase of 5 percent from the same period a year ago, the specialty retailer said in a statement.
Same store sales for the 35 weeks to October 5, 1996 fell two percent from a year ago. Net sales for the thirty-five weeks also decreased by two percent to $121.1 million.

Adjusting net sales for the shift in the retail calendar, comparable store sales increased one percent and decreased three percent for the five and thirty- five week periods ended October 5, 1996, respectively, the company noted.
Gantos also said Rick Bunka has been promoted from vice president-finance and chief financial officer to senior vice president-finance and chief financial officer.
Bunka will take on additional responsibility for strategic planning.

In other management changes, Gantos said Vicki Boudreaux has been appointed vice president-planning and allocation. Prior to joining Gantos, Boudreaux was a vice president at Casual Corner Group Inc, a specialty retailer.
Gantos, a specialty retailer of women's wear and accessories, currently operates 114 stores in 23 states.
